subject.title: fix(auth-health): prefer usable OAuth over expired inventory in provider status

question: Should a provider-level healthy OAuth profile override only stale expired inventory, or may it also override missing OAuth profiles in the Model Auth rollup?
rationale: This PR changes an auth-provider status contract that affects operator-visible UI/API/CLI warnings, and the current branch broadens the override beyond the stale-expired case described by the report.

options.title: Keep Missing Visible
options.body: Require the branch to keep missing OAuth profiles red while narrowing the healthy override to stale expired inventory, with tests and real behavior proof.

options.title: Accept Healthy Overrides Missing
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally decide that any usable OAuth profile makes missing sibling inventory non-blocking, but that status contract should be recorded before merge.

options.title: Pause For Canonical Scope
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide whether the canonical stale-badge report needs this rollup change, the Overview refresh PR, or both.

recommendation.title: Keep Missing Visible
recommendation.body: Require the branch to keep missing OAuth profiles red while narrowing the healthy override to stale expired inventory, with tests and real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent auth-provider status and Codex sidecar alignment commits make this the strongest available owner for the status-contract decision.
